english.title: Return to Bristol airport after request to leave by constable / airport official
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having left Bristol Airport at the request of a constable or an airport official,

(A)_[re-entered the airport other than as a bona fide airline passenger]_
(B)_[re-entered the airport other than subject to any conditions of re-entry stipulated by a constable or airport official]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.27 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
